blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Presiding officer and Senator-judge Francis “Chiz” Escudero on Monday reminded all parties before the Senate impeachment court to observe civility and professionalism as tensions continued to rise in the proceedings, including those arising from “rantings or tantrums inside or outside the courtroom.” READ: LIVE UPDATES: Sara Duterte impeachment trial | Oct. 5, 2026 Escudero made the pronouncement right at the beginning of the 33rd day of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial in which he acknowledged how emotions were now running high at the current stage of the hearings.
